capabilities: insert timestamps automatically as you type
insert a timestamp at the cursor via a command
extras: README is short and refers to an external page for valid datetime format options; configuration details are shown only in screenshots.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically add timestamps at the cursor while writing.
summary: Timestamp plugin that inserts timestamps into the document as you type, with a configurable datetime format and a command for cursor-position insertion.
